new.name: IDENTIFIES_SPECIFICATION_AMBIGUITY
new.definition: The reasoning explicitly flags that a requirement or specification admits multiple interpretations or lacks sufficient detail for a unique action.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the ambiguous requirement or specification detail.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a specific requirement, field, or rule that is ambiguous or open to multiple readings.
The reasoning signals uncertainty or the existence of competing possible interpretations.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates requirements without acknowledging any ambiguity.
The reasoning makes a choice without noting that an ambiguity or interpretation issue exists.

new.name: SYNTHESIZES_OBSERVATIONS_INTO_UNIFIED_MODEL
new.definition: The reasoning integrates content from multiple distinct observations into a single combined representation or understanding rather than treating them independently.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text combining information from multiple observations.

parameters.name: observations
parameters.description: The observations whose contents are integrated into the combined representation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references or restates content from at least two distinct observations.
The reasoning produces a unified model, state, schema, or summary that combines the observed information.
The reasoning cross-references information across the observations rather than only listing them separately.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning references only one observation.
The reasoning lists observations independently without deriving any combined representation.
No integrated understanding or combined model is stated.

new.name: DERIVES_UNIFIED_SCHEMA_MAPPING_FROM_OBSERVATIONS
new.definition: The reasoning specifies correspondences between differently named fields or schema elements observed in multiple sources and a common target schema.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text defining field or schema correspondences between observed sources and a unified schema.

parameters.name: observations
parameters.description: The observations exposing the source schemas or field names used to derive the mapping.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least two differently named source fields as equivalent to one target field or schema element.
The mapping is based on source structures or field names exposed by the observations.
The reasoning addresses correspondences across multiple observed source schemas.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only repeats field names from a single source without cross-source correspondence.
No equivalence between differently named fields or schema elements is stated.
The mapping is unrelated to the observed source structures.

uncertain.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUITY_WITH_EXPLICIT_RATIONALE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning evaluates competing interpretations of an acknowledged ambiguity and selects one using a stated rationale tied to requirements, data, or expected outcomes.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text weighing interpretations and selecting a resolution.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning presents at least two possible interpretations or courses of action for an ambiguous point.
The reasoning selects one interpretation or course of action.
The reasoning provides a rationale connecting the selection to requirements, observed data, or expected consequences.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only identifies an ambiguity without selecting an interpretation.
The reasoning selects an interpretation without presenting alternatives or giving a rationale.

uncertain.name: IMPLEMENTS_PLANNED_LOGIC_IN_ARTIFACT
uncertain.definition: An action creates or writes a persistent implementation artifact that encodes logic or procedure specified in reasoning.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that creates or writes the implementation artifact.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text specifying the logic, procedure, or algorithm to be embodied in the artifact.

assertion_conditions: The action's arguments indicate creation or writing of a persistent file or artifact.
The reasoning specifies intended logic, procedure, or algorithm for that artifact.
The action content corresponds to the logic or procedure stated in the reasoning.
exclusion_conditions: The action only executes existing code or inspects resources.
The reasoning does not specify logic to be implemented.
No persistent implementation artifact is created or written.

uncertain.name: VERIFIES_OUTPUT_AGAINST_STATED_REQUIREMENTS
uncertain.definition: A validation action tests produced outputs against requirements or expected properties explicitly stated in reasoning, and its result observation reports evidence about whether those checks passed.

parameters.name: validation_action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that executes checks or assertions against the produced outputs.

parameters.name: criteria_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the requirements or expected properties to validate.

parameters.name: validation_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the check results or observed values relevant to the stated criteria.

assertion_conditions: The criteria reasoning states specific requirements, properties, or expected values to be checked.
The validation action executes assertions, inspections, or comparisons targeting those requirements.
The validation observation reports pass/fail status or observed values that address the stated criteria.
exclusion_conditions: The action generates output rather than checking it against criteria.
The observation merely displays output without comparison to stated requirements.
No explicit validation criteria are stated in the reasoning.

uncertain.name: DECLARES_TASK_COMPLETION_WITH_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning asserts that the task or deliverable is complete and cites successful verification results or fulfilled requirements as support.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text declaring completion and referencing verification evidence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly states that the task or deliverable is complete.
The reasoning cites verification results, passed checks, or satisfied requirements as evidence for completion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only plans future work or reports intermediate progress.
The reasoning claims completion without referencing verification evidence or fulfilled requirements.
